name: ISP Ltd
summary: Melbourne ISP operator trading as ispau.net (AS4752); an AusBone Melbourne (MEL-BONE) exchange participant; referred to as the parent of budget brand BlazeNet, which folded into Hotkey Internet Services.

events.details: AusBone Melbourne (MEL-BONE) participant (AS4752); parent of the BlazeNet brand.

Death researched Aug 2026: ISP Ltd Melbourne AS4752; parent of BlazeNet which folded into Hotkey. Hotkey deregistered 21 Jul 2023 but that's not ISP Ltd itself. No ABR deregistration found for ISP Ltd.
ISP Ltd (AS4752) parent of BlazeNet which folded into Hotkey Internet Services ~2004; last ispau.net capture Feb/Mar 2001.
